whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Is Your Social Media Just an 'Empty Storefront'?
whatIs.paragraph1: Irregular posts, amateur visuals that don't reflect your brand's quality, and content that only gets a few likes... Could your social media be costing you prestige instead of adding value to your business?
whatIs.paragraph2: In today's digital world, social media management is not just about posting a few times a week. It requires strategic planning that understands algorithms, a creative visual language, and instant optimization.
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we find your brand's unique voice, build an emotional connection with your target audience, and transform your social media into active channels that directly serve sales and awareness.

physical.title: Entrepreneurs Launching a New Brand
physical.description: I want to make a bold entry into the industry and put my brand's digital presence on a professional foundation from day one.

startup.title: Businesses with Stagnant Accounts
startup.description: I can't post regularly, my follower count has been the same for months, and my posts generate zero engagement from my target audience.

growing.title: Those Aiming for Sales and Conversions
growing.description: I don't just want my social media to look pretty; I want it to drive traffic to my website, generate leads, and bring direct sales.

global.title: Managers with No Time
global.description: Between managing my business and operations, I absolutely have no time to create content, reply to comments, and follow trends.

whatWeDo.label: How We Help You
whatWeDo.title: 360-Degree Management from Strategy to Posting
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We start by listening and analyzing. We determine your brand's current situation, what your competitors are doing, and what your target audience wants to consume, then we draw up a custom content strategy for you.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: In line with this strategy, we produce aesthetic graphic designs, trendy Reels/TikTok videos, and engaging copywriting. The monthly calendar we prepare never goes live without your approval.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: We don't just post content and walk away. We reply to comments, manage direct messages (DMs), intervene during crises, and present you with a transparent performance report at the end of each month to show how much we've grown.
whatWeDo.cardDescription: All the creative and analytical processes your brand needs to shine digitally, under one roof.

whyUs.label: Why Sybor Digital?
whyUs.title: We View Social Media as a Marketing Tool
whyUs.subtitle: Your strategic business partner that adds value to your brand, not just an agency that 'posts'.

reason1.title: Content with a Purpose
reason1.description: We don't produce empty content just to fill the page. Every visual we prepare has a clear purpose: to entertain, educate, or drive sales.

reason2.title: Mastery of Platform Algorithms
reason2.description: From Instagram's latest algorithm to TikTok's organic distribution logic, we know the rules of the platforms and optimize content accordingly.

reason3.title: Flawless Brand Consistency
reason3.description: To create a premium brand perception when someone looks at your profile, we stay 100% true to your color palette, fonts, and visual language.

reason4.title: No Surprises (Approved Process)
reason4.description: We present you with next month's content calendar and designs in advance. Nothing is posted on behalf of your brand until you see and approve it.

reason5.title: Sustainable Organic Growth
reason5.description: We don't fall for fake follower (bot) or giveaway traps that are temporary and harm the brand. Our goal is to gain you a loyal audience that will actually buy your product/service.

reason6.title: Fast Reaction to Trends
reason6.description: Social media is lived in the moment. We quickly adapt to a viral trend in your industry or an instant development (real-time marketing) and produce content.

process.label: Process
process.title: How Do We Manage the Process?
process.subtitle: Our planned and transparent workflow that eliminates chaos.

discovery.title: Discovery & Strategy Setup
discovery.description: We audit your current accounts and examine your competitors. We structure your brand language, visual identity, and the first month's content strategy.

design.title: Content Creation & Approval Process
design.description: We write copy in line with the determined strategy, prepare designs, and present the monthly content calendar for your approval.

development.title: Publishing & Community Management
development.description: We publish the approved content during the algorithm's most active hours and manage incoming comments and messages on behalf of your brand.

launch.title: Reporting & Optimization
launch.description: At the end of the month, we report your growth data and reach statistics, and we improve the next month's strategy based on this data.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about social media management processes.

delivery.question: When and how do we start the process?
delivery.answer: After the contract, our brand analysis and strategy creation phase begins. Usually, within the first 7-10 days, we analyze your brand and present your first monthly content calendar for your approval.

pricing.question: How are monthly management fees determined?
pricing.answer: We create a custom package for you based on the number of platforms to be managed (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.), weekly posting frequency, video/Reels production volume, and your ad management needs.

revisions.question: Will I be able to see the content before it's posted?
revisions.answer: Absolutely yes. The monthly content calendar (visuals and texts) is presented for your approval the week before. No content goes live without your approval or requested revisions.

maintenance.question: Why do you recommend a minimum 3-month contract?
maintenance.answer: To allow social media algorithms to recognize your account, for our strategy to settle in, and to capture a real, measurable organic growth momentum, a steady effort of at least 3 months is essential.

migration.question: Do I give you the passwords to my accounts; how is security ensured?
migration.answer: We don't ask for your password. You authorize our agency as a 'Partner' through Meta Business Manager. This way, your accounts remain secure while we take over the management.

mobile.question: Is the sponsored ad budget included in the service fee?
mobile.answer: No, ad spend (the amount paid to Google/Meta) is drawn entirely from your credit card and based on the budget you determine. We manage the campaign setup, targeting, and optimization.
